title: ClassificationNeuralNetwork Predict
text: Classify observations using neural network classification model, 1 input, 2 outputs, direct feedthrough, {Score data type} sets Data type of score output Inherit:; {Select trained machine learning model} sets the neural network classification model, {Add output port for predicted class scores} adds second output port for predicted class, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the prevention of fixed-point tools from overriding data, {Label data type} sets the data type of label output, {Label data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of label output for range checking, {Label data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of label output for range checking, {Score data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of score output for range checking, {Score data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of score output for range checking, {Raw score data type} sets the untransformed score data type Inherit, {Raw score data type Minimum} sets the minimum untransformed score for range checking, {Raw score data type Maximum} sets the maximum untransformed score for range checking, {Output layer data type} sets the data type of final fully connected layer, {Output layer data type Minimum} sets the minimum value for final fully connected layer, {Output layer data type Maximum} sets the maximum value for final fully connected layer, {Layer 1 data type} sets the data type of first fully connected layer, {Layer 1 data type Minimum} sets the minimum value for first fully connected layer and {Layer 1 data type Maximum} sets the maximum value for first fully connected layer. Values come from the instance.
